purpose: Operational token-budget follow-up, selected only for empty max_output_tokens incompletions from initial seven-model API pilot. Not a replacement of first calls and not a common-budget cross-model efficacy experiment.
selection_rule: All and only initial rows status=incomplete, output empty, incomplete_details.reason=max_output_tokens. No model preference or answer-based selection.
timeout_scope: Per socket operation, not hard wall-clock
stopping: Attempt each frozen follow-up row once; retain HTTP errors, incomplete/empty outputs and do not retry again.
analysis: Separate initial and follow-up outcomes, label initial unscorable. A later returned answer does not retroactively complete the first response or prove a model ranking. API alias is not immutable checkpoint. Human pending.
budget: At current documented short-input hosted rates the additional three calls remain below 0.1 credits if those prices apply. Retain reported usage.cost without assuming account balance or USD equivalence.
